facts.material: aluminum alloy footpegs (approx. 1,550 g) with stainless-steel mounting hardware (approx. 150 g)
facts.form: kit of two model-specific auxiliary footpegs with hardware, mounted to motorcycle frame

gri_path: Section XVII note 2: footpegs are not parts of general use (Section XV note 2) nor otherwise excluded; the stainless mounting hardware is packaged with the kit and follows it
Section XVII note 3: footpegs are model-specific and suitable solely or principally for motorcycles of heading 8711
GRI 1: heading 8714 covers parts and accessories of vehicles of headings 8711 to 8713; 8714.10 of motorcycles

rejected_alternatives.reason: article of aluminum; Section XVII note 3 places dedicated motorcycle accessories in 8714
obsolete numbering used in older rulings; current line is 8714.10.00.50

classification.rationale: The auxiliary footpegs are model-specific accessories that mount to the motorcycle frame, so under Section XVII note 3 they are suitable solely or principally for motorcycles, and no exclusion in Section XVII note 2 applies. Heading 8714 covers parts and accessories of motorcycles. CBP classified a motorcycle Highway Peg Kit as motorcycle parts and accessories (G88285, under the older 8714.19.0060 numbering), and current rulings use 8714.10.0050 (N340630). The kit falls in 8714.10.00.50.
